description: Head reads refuse a symlinked file, a symlinked directory component, '..'/'.'/empty/.git components, an absolute path, a directory, a symlink loop, and a file over MAX_HEAD_FILE_BYTES — each would otherwise yield an enclosing anchor and changed_lines, as the regular file alongside does. A counterpart reference to a symlinked file is skipped without spending the readable-path budget.
